coined_name_warning: The tree spells this class Scuttlebug; the cartridge's RTTI spells it daSpd_c (spd = spider, and the registry profile is g_profile_SPIDER at 0x02122c08). ov071/symbols.txt aliases the VTABLE under both names at one address but does NOT alias _ZTI/_ZTS. That asymmetry is what blocks the promotion -- see notes below.

vtable.note: the symbol IS the address point; the two ABI preamble words (offset-to-top, RTTI pointer) sit at -8 and -4
vtable.evidence: THREE independent tools agree. (1) mwccarm's own emitted storage size, harvested from a deliberately unlicensed verify run: EXTRA .data _ZTV10Scuttlebug size=0x84. (2) tools/rtti_vtables.py --own daSpd_c -> 31 slots (base dActor_c 31). It answers only to the ROM RTTI spelling: --own Scuttlebug prints nothing. (3) The relocation run in relocs.txt: 0x02122c28 (the typeinfo preamble word) through 0x02122ca4 with no gap, closing immediately before data_ov071_02122ca8, which is also what the naive next-symbol read gives here (0x02122ca8 - 0x02122c2c = 0x7c). All three land on 0x7c / 31 slots / 0x84 storage.

base_evidence: _ZTI7daSpd_c is a __si_class_type_info whose +8 word relocates to _ZTI8dActor_c (arm9 0x0208e390), so the direct base is dActor_c and nothing else. Corroborated by length: _ZTV8dActor_c and _ZTV7daSpd_c are both 31 slots -- this class adds no slot, it only overrides.

overrides.name: OnPendingDestroy
overrides.note: empty body; the override exists only to occupy the slot

overrides.name: ~Scuttlebug (D1)
overrides.note: the FIRST byte of ov071's .text; the header defines the destructor inline, which is what makes mwccarm emit D1 then D0 with no D2

overrides.name: OnYoshiTryEat
overrides.note: THE KEY FUNCTION: with the destructor inline this is the first non-inline virtual the class declares, so the TU that defines it emits _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS. Body returns the constant 6.

inherited_unchanged_slots: every slot other than 0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 16, 17, 18, 19 and 29 holds dActor_c's own word.

shard_count_correction.why: tools/tu_map.py cuts on symbol NAME. daSpd_c_classInit at 0x02120618 is not spelt _ZN10Scuttlebug..., so it was never labelled and never counted, even though _ZN10Scuttlebug13OnTurnIntoEggER6Player ends at exactly 0x02120580 + 0x98 = 0x02120618 -- a ZERO-byte gap. Its delinks.txt entry is src/d_a_spd.c. ov071 puts each class's <class>_classInit last in its own run: the promoted daEyBm_c carries daEyBm_c_classInit as its 13th member, and daObjCasket_c and daEykn_c do the same.

size_evidence: daSpd_c_classInit's own literal: fBase_c::operator new(940 = 0x3ac). The trailing byte fields close exactly on it, and ~Scuttlebug destroys the four members in reverse.

members.name: mTimer
members.note: typed u8 in the header but read and written as a HALFWORD by six members

compiler_only_output_measured.derivation: 2 x (3 ancestors + self) + 1 vtable = 9, plus 1 for _ZN7Vector3D1Ev because the TU odr-uses Vector3 at all (four function locals -- three in func_ov071_0211f148, one in func_ov071_0211f8d0 -- and the term is +1 however many objects). No file-local anonymous struct holds them, so no extra @class$ destructor.

unproven: the original SM64DS spelling of daSpd_c_classInit (historical project alias Scuttlebug_Spawn) and of Scuttlebug_SetState
the English names of the 29 auto-named func_ov071_* state handlers and helpers -- their class ownership, bodies, calls and ordering are proven, their names are not
what mTimer expiring means: six members read and write it as a halfword and Behavior discards DecIfAbove0_Short's result
the 4-byte gap at 0x0d0 -- no load or store in this class's 37 functions touches it
whether g_profile_SPIDER at 0x02122c08 belongs to this TU's data band; it is not claimed here and the TU does not define it (the promoted sibling daEyBm_c does claim its own g_profile_EYEKUN_BEAM)
